name: Lakeside Orchards and Farm Market
tagline: Lakeside Orchards and Farm Market at https://www.lakesideorchards.com/
description: Lakeside Orchards and Farm Market is a family-run farm in 318 Readfield Rd, ME. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
